An Unmatched Location in Belmayne
Nestled in the heart of Dublin 13, O’Neill Court boasts an enviable location that truly sets it apart. Positioned just 2km from Clarehall Shopping Centre and 3km from Baldoyle Village, residents have access to a wealth of retail, dining, and leisure options within minutes. The development is seamlessly connected to Dublin’s extensive transport network, with Clongriffin Train Station and multiple bus routes only a short walk away, and Dublin Airport just a 15-minute drive for ultimate convenience. O’Neill Court's proximity to the breathtaking Howth Peninsula offers residents the opportunity to explore scenic walking trails, indulge in fresh seafood at vibrant local restaurants, and enjoy the coastal beauty of Dublin. With stunning beaches like Portmarnock and Burrow Beach nearby and renowned golf clubs such as Portmarnock and Howth Golf Club just a short drive away, the location ensures an unparalleled lifestyle combining urban convenience and natural charm.

prs.location:
Quayside Quarter is conveniently located in Dublin Docklands, only 5 minutes from the Docklands rapid rail station (DART) and directly next to the Spencer Dock light rail station (LUAS).
From Quayside Quarter, Point Square can be reached in approximately 1 minute on foot, while offices in the IFSC are approximately 4 minutes away on foot. Dublin Airport is approximately 20 minutes away by taxi.

Dublin Docklands Neighbourhood
The neighbourhood draws its inspiration from the fabric of Dublin and the rich industrial heritage of the Docklands, infused with contemporary Scandinavian architectural accents and Brooklyn loft-style design. Curated wild landscapes sit alongside bustling streets with restaurants, cafés and stores. A riverfront boutique hotel anchors the area, contributing to a vibrant new neighbourhood.

Contact Quayside Quarter
To contact a member of the Quayside Quarter site team, email team@qquarter.com or call 01 5395960.

listing.title: The Alliance, The Gasworks, Barrow Street, Dublin 4
listing.seoTitle: The Alliance, The Gasworks, Barrow Street, Dublin 4

prs.location:
Next door to Google’s European Headquarters, The Alliance takes pride of place in this urban quarter, bringing a sense of heritage to a district famed for its incredible eateries, sociable atmosphere and ability to attract innovative companies. 

If you like staying local, you have plenty to entertain you with walks along the leafy Grand Canal, the lush Merrion Square nearby along with Aviva Stadium, Bord Gais Energy Theatre and a host of gyms. 

Your inner foodie will appreciate Juniors Deli & Café and Farmer Browns for elevenses and lunch, along with the Schoolhouse Hotel, The Bath Pub, The Chophouse and The Old Spot among other incredible eateries, conveniently located nearby, for tasty evenings out. 

With only a 15-minute walk to St. Stephen’s Green, you can meet friends last minute or hop on the Dart at Grand Canal Dock, which is 100 metres from your door. You can even hire a bike with Dublinbikes just five minutes away at Herbert Place.

listing.title: Alto Vetro, Grand Canal Square, Dublin 2
listing.seoTitle: Alto Vetro, Grand Canal Square, Dublin 2

prs.location:
Alto Vetro is on the west side of Grand Canal Dock, a popular area for the arts and enterprise, making the Bord Gais Energy Theatre, 3Arena and a host of international companies from Google to Accenture part of your neighbourhood. 

If you want to stay local, the Art of Coffee is in the building. The celebrated Marker Hotel is 500 metres away, affording you a choice of spa treatments, fine food and tempting cocktails. While Il Valentino is the quintessential Italian bakery and café on Grand Canal Harbour, tempting every sense.

Getting around the city is easy in this connected location with Grand Canal Dock Dart station only five minutes away and Dublinbikes at your door. The best of Dublin’s activities await you from shopping on Grafton Street to coastal walks along Sandymount Strand.

prs.tagLine: A Renaissance for Rented Apartment Living
prs.location:
At Seafield Strand, you get the best of all worlds. Commuting is a breeze thanks to easy access to key transport links like the M1, M50, Sutton train station, Dublin Airport and Dublin bus routes. And when you need to escape the hustle and bustle of the city, there’s Seafield Strand beach and Howth Hill cliff walk right on your doorstep.

The development is enviably positioned with a host of local amenities just a gentle stroll away. You can work up a sweat at Sutton Golf Club, Binn Eadair GAA or the Suttonions Rugby Club. Then unwind with a sweet treat or freshly brewed coffee at the local Starbucks, Insomnia or Minetta Delicatessen.

Experience a lifestyle beyond compare, where luxury, comfort, and breathtaking natural beauty unite. Unrivalled transport connections through the DART and Dublin Bus networks ensure you’re effortlessly connected to the city while revelling in the oasis you call home.
